description: Tailors a resume to a job description for ATS screening, or improves it in general. The base resume does not change. Uses AI credits. resume_text is optional and takes the text of a resume the user pasted or attached in the chat. Without it, the tool uses the resume already on the user's account. In ChatGPT, resume_file takes a resume file the user attached.

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description (optional; without it, the optimization is general)

resume_file.description: A resume file the user attached in ChatGPT, as the file itself. GetMattered reads it once: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to optimize. The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Left out, the resume already on the user's GetMattered account is used.

name: getmattered_optimize_resume

setupStep.description: Present while account setup is open: the first setup step.

title: Optimize Resume
